CustomField.description: Turn on "Generate with Agentforce" in the template Designer. Off by default: the Einstein provider ships inside the package, so DocGen cannot tell whether AI is usable simply by checking whether the class is present. Switch this on only after Einstein/Prompt Builder is enabled and the DocGen_HTML_Body prompt template exists and is Activated — otherwise authors get a button that fails when they press it. See docs/AGENTFORCE_SETUP.md.
CustomField.label: Enable AI Authoring
